chart.title: Equal highs > no excess
chart.subtitle: Buyers still there at the top...

caption:
Flat high. No tail. Price RETURNS. 📊

Nasdaq stalls at 24,560 and prints three equal highs. On the footprint the top tick still shows real volume on both the bid and the ask: no buying tail, no excess, no one-sided rejection. That's a poor high, an auction that ended without finishing. Price rotates 80 points lower, then comes back, runs through 24,560 and takes every stop parked just above it.

1️⃣ Spot it: equal highs with two-sided volume at the top tick and no tail
2️⃣ Don't treat it as a strong ceiling or hide your stop just above it
3️⃣ Use it as a target: unfinished auctions tend to get repaired
